scope: Explicit transcription application bridge with exact owned audio and raw response recovery
activation: No launcher or narration UI activation

pipeline.recovery: Forced raw-spool SQL failure followed by reopen; no prepare, credential resolution, media probing, conversion or repeat POST
pipeline.outcome: Speech succeeded; raw transcript remains ingesting/reserved without a candidate ingester
pipeline.timingEvidence: Original 6.000001-second endpoint remains flagged as out of source even though 48 kHz rounding yields the last source sample

privateBackup.failedAssertion: Source directory equality: expected ownership file and SQLite sidecars were added

limits: HTTP responses and human fixture principals are synthetic; no live provider access, speech recognition quality, actual pricing or browser approval is verified.
Plan/grant seeding uses trusted host services; spending issuance and both Engine admissions are actual application paths.
The recovery harness manually expires an attempt lease and reopens the database; it does not measure natural expiry or kill a process.
Raw lookup verifies stored source/preparation identities and raw output bytes; future candidate ingestion and backup verify the required source/derivative bytes.

Concurrent callers after a dispatch marker cannot repeat POST. Concurrent missing-derivative preparation is not coalesced; owned pre-marker MEDIA_BUSY is a definite local failure with consumed allowance capacity retained.
The backup disposition preserves its failed initial inventory assertion and expected runtime sidecars; it does not claim the source directory remained identical.
Transcript candidate ingestion, human adoption and opt-in audio activation remain separate work.
